name: Lovable

tiers.name: Free

limits.grants: 20 credits/mo Cloud grant + 4 credits/mo AI grant

estimatedTokenBudget.assumptions: ~30 usable credits/mo * ~100K tokens per build+agent mix

tiers.notes: Daily credits reset at 00:00 UTC; monthly grants on 1st; no rollover

tiers.name: Pro 100

limits.dailyFloor: 5 daily build credits + 20 Cloud + 4 AI grants stack on top
limits.rollover: Monthly credits roll over (expire 2 months later on monthly billing)

estimatedTokenBudget.assumptions: ~150K tokens per credit across builds, hosting and AI gateway usage; scales to 10,000 credits ($2,250/mo)

tiers.notes: Unified credit balance covers builds + Cloud hosting + AI gateway on deployed apps

tiers.name: Business

limits.buildCredits: 100 credits tier at $50/mo (annual $42) - scales with tier
limits.privacy: Workspace data excluded from AI model training by default

estimatedTokenBudget.description: Business minimum tier (~40M tokens/mo at 200+ cr tiers typical)
estimatedTokenBudget.assumptions: Same per-credit token estimate as Pro; minimum $50 tier

tiers.notes: SSO/central admin at higher Business tiers; Enterprise custom

gotchas: Credits are a unified balance covering app builds, hosting (Cloud) and AI gateway usage of deployed apps
Free-tier credits do NOT roll over; Pro credits expire 2 months after issue on monthly plans
Daily 5 build credits are a floor, not a bonus: monthly credits also include daily research
Higher credit tiers scale steeply: 200 cr $50, 400 cr $100, 800 cr $200 ... 10,000 cr $2,250
tosHighlights: Business and Enterprise exclude workspace data from AI model training by default
Free/Pro can opt out per account
dataTraining: Excluded by default on Business+; opt-out available on Free/Pro
